identificationModule.briefTitle: Engineering fixture — T1D public-registry criteria research (not a live recruitment claim)

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Age 8-45 years
Diagnosis of Type 1 diabetes
Documented disease stage at screening
Autoantibody status recorded per protocol
C-peptide measurement within 30 days of screening
Prior therapy washout timing known to investigator
Investigator judgment on concurrent infection risk

identificationModule.briefTitle: Engineering fixture — T2D public-registry criteria research (not a live recruitment claim)

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Age ≥ 18 years
Age ≤ 75 years
Diagnosis of Type 2 diabetes
Current medication timing documented
